subject: PO translation / remit-split matrix for multi-entity invoicing (Novaterra)
messages:
From: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@novaterra.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@novaterra.com>, finance@novaterra.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 +0200
Subject: Vendor registration + PO translation matrix for multi-ledger billing

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking this on. Novaterra is preparing to onboard Redwood as a vendor across three legal entities (Novaterra NL, Novaterra FR, Novaterra GmbH). Our AP team has a couple of non-standard requirements we need to confirm before we create the vendor records:

- PO translation: our ERP ingests a single PO per invoice but we sometimes receive a single invoice that must be split across two "billto" entities (for example marketing vs R&D cost centers). We need a translation layer that maps each incoming PO line to the correct billto_party and GL bucket.
- Split settlement: remits must be routed to different bank details depending on the entity/sub-ledger; sometimes 70% to NL account, 30% to FR account.
- PO fingerprint/URN: please include the PO identifier and a stable invoice header URN so we can reconcile automated matches.

I've attached our AP spec and an example PO XML. Could you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Accept a header-level PO and return an invoice with explicit per-line mapping (or provide an exported mapping file we can ingest).
2) Produce an invoice with a remit-split matrix (fields we can map into our payment rails).
3) Support a UAT window with test invoices (we can open a sandbox vendor).

Attachment: [Novaterra_AP_Specs_v3.pdf (PDF)]
Attachment: [PO-sample-12345.xml]

Appreciate if you can loop in the ops person who will do the file/EDI testing.

Best,
Sophie Lemaire
Head of Procurement Operations
Novaterra Inc

From: aditya_rao@redwood.example <aditya_rao@redwood.example>
To: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@novaterra.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:40:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO translation matrix for multi-ledger billing

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear spec and the example PO. Looping in Kim (payments) and Marissa (partner onboarding) to coordinate.

Quick answers up front:
- Yes, we can produce per-line mapping output. Our recommendation is to add a small "translation token" in the invoice payload: "billto_chain" that contains the target ledger id and GL code per PO line. That makes it trivial for your ingestion layer to route each line.
- Remit-split can be expressed as an array of {percentage, remit_account_id, currency} on the invoice header; we can generate that from our billing config when you provide the split matrix.
- Sandbox UAT: happy to run a 48-hour UAT window with test invoices. We request one canonical test PO per split pattern (e.g., single-entity, two-way split, three-way split).

Action items for Novaterra:
1) Confirm the remit account IDs and percentage splits for each legal entity.
2) Provide expected GL codes per billto_party.
3) Share preferred test schedule (we can support evenings CET if that helps).

Kim — can you confirm the file formats our billing engine will emit for PO/mapping export? We typically support JSON invoice with an attached XML proof (UBL or a small custom mapping) and can also produce an EDIFACT snippet if needed.

Marissa — I'll need a point of contact on Novaterra side for vendor provisioning (name + phone) so we can spin up the sandbox vendor.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.example <kimberly_park@redwood.example>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example
Cc: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@novaterra.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO translation matrix for multi-ledger billing

On Tue, Jun 30, 2026 at 16:40 Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example> wrote:
> Kim — can you confirm the file formats our billing engine will emit for PO/mapping export?

Hi all — confirming the formats and the test plan. Our billing export options for the Novaterra workflow: 
- Preferred: JSON invoice envelope with a "line_mappings" array (fields: po_number, po_line_id, billto_chain, gl_code, net_amount).
- Alternate: UBL 2.1 with an added extension block for "billto_chain" and a header block for "remit_split".
- EDIFACT: we can provide a small sample, but we'd prefer JSON/UBL for ease of mapping.

For remits: we will accept a remit-split matrix as header attributes and create a payment-distribution.csv in the sandbox for your AP to validate bank routing.

Proposed UAT schedule: July 7-9 (evenings CET for a quiet production window). We will submit:
- 3 test invoices (single-entity, 2-way split, 3-way split)
- 1 negative test (missing GL / unmatched PO line) to verify exception handling

Sophie — can ProcureOps confirm whether the ERP expects a consolidated invoice reference (one URN) or multiple invoice references when lines span multiple legal entities? That will determine whether we emit a single invoice with multiple billto_chain entries or separate invoice documents.

Attachments we will upload to the sandbox: [PO-sample-12345.xml], [payment-distribution.csv (generated during tests)].

Kimberly Park
Payments Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@novaterra.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.example, aditya_rao@redwood.example
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, ProcureOps <procureops@novaterra.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 11:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO translation matrix for multi-ledger billing

Thanks — this looks good. Quick answers:
- ERP expects a single invoice URN when the supplier sends one file; we will accept a header-level URN and will handle line-level billto routing internally.
- We'll provide the remit account IDs and GL mappings by Monday EOD (attached a small CSV template).
- Confirming UAT: July 7-9 evenings CET works. ProcureOps will create a sandbox vendor and share credentials with Marissa.

ProcureOps note: Sophie Lemaire will be the primary AP contact for runbook sign-off; please CC finance@novaterra.com on the sandbox access email.

Sophie
---
Novaterra AP attach: [Novaterra_remit_gl_template.csv] (will follow in separate email)
